note: Every college in VCI's list of recognised veterinary colleges (First Schedule to the Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984) and its list of provisionally recognised colleges with a Letter of Permission, both as on 22.10.2026. VCI publishes no college codes, so each college is keyed by a hash of its state, name and town. city is the town VCI writes with the college; district is filled only where VCI's name or address gives one ('Town, District' or 'Dist. X'). B.V.Sc. & A.H. seats for recognised colleges are the 'Seats Approved by Central Govt.' in VCI's seats list, which is undated but covers the same 73 colleges; every college's 15% VCI quota in the 2026-27 counselling bulletin (https://www.vci.dahd.gov.in/sites/default/files/News%20update/CompositIBAY2026-27.pdf, Annexure 2, 858 seats in 64 colleges) is within rounding of 15% of those seats, except Ayodhya and Meerut (100 approved seats, quota 12). That quota is kept as vci_quota_seats. VCI prints no seats for provisionally recognised colleges: where a VCI meeting recommended the LOP for a stated number of annual admissions, that number is used and the minutes are the source; the rest stay null. recognised_from is the date from which VCI recognises the degree ('granted on or after'). VCI publishes no college-wise M.V.Sc. list, so no M.V.Sc. intake is recorded. College of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Jalukie is printed under Mizoram (Central Agricultural University) but is in Nagaland. same_as links the college to the NIRF record for the same institution (checked by hand); constituent colleges are not linked to their parent universities.
